executive_summary.description: Summarize overall Q2 supplier performance, identify the main concern, and state the management decision. Use only supplied evidence and cite source filenames inline.
executive_summary.title: Executive Summary

kpi_overview.description: Create a Markdown table for Nordic Components, Baltic Fasteners, Alpine Sensors, and Overall. Show total deliveries, on-time delivery percentage, total units, defective units percentage, and spend in EUR. Calculate from the KPI workbook and round percentages to one decimal place.
kpi_overview.title: Kpi Overview

supplier_findings.description: Give a separate evidence-grounded finding for each supplier, combining the KPI workbook with relevant audit, incident, and meeting evidence.
supplier_findings.title: Supplier Findings

risks.description: Describe supported quality and delivery risks. Explicitly identify the approximate EUR 410,000 meeting-note figure versus the exact workbook spend instead of silently choosing the approximate number.
risks.title: Risks

actions.description: Create a table with Action, Owner, Due Date, and Completion Condition. Include only actions explicitly stated in the evidence.
actions.title: Actions

source_references.description: List every source file used in the report. Use exact filenames.
source_references.title: Source References
